answer: An agent marketplace requires each active identity to lock 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days before it can bid for work, with each deposit backing only one identity at a time. Agents named juniper, onyx, and cedar face the same rule. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, giving up liquidity and potential returns elsewhere. Creating new names cannot reuse the locked capital.
